title: Test: wolfHSM RSA key + OAEP returns CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID
description: In USBFLASH=1+WOLFHSM=1 builds, a wolfHSM RSA key presented to C_Encrypt/C_Decrypt OAEP must return CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID (the else branch in the is_ks check). This combination has no test. Need to add a test in test/wp11_test_backend_wolfhsm.c that: generates or imports a wolfHSM RSA key, calls C_EncryptInit(CKM_RSA_PKCS_OAEP)+C_Encrypt, asserts CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID. Same for C_Decrypt.
